name: MCP Hub
description: MCP Hub aggregates and proxies multiple Model Context Protocol servers into a unified Streamable HTTP interface. It allows users to combine diverse stdio, SSE, and HTTP-based servers while providing tool namespacing, health monitoring, and secure authentication.
